basic_details.job_title: Medical Education Department Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Section Officer, Senior Grade Stenographer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Medical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra has announced 5 contract vacancies for Senior Grade Stenographer, Section Officer, and Assistant Section Officer posts. Eligible retired government servants can apply offline by post or in person to the Establishment, Medical Education Department, Gokuldas Tejpal Hospital Complex Building, 9th Floor, New Mantralaya, with the last date for submission being 5 November 2026. qualification.details: Eligibility: Retired government personnel having a minimum of 3 years of work experience on the post of Senior Stenographer (Higher Grade Stenographer). Must possess practical experience in Marathi and English shorthand dictation, planning officers' daily diaries, meetings, and tour schedules, as well as maintaining official files and dak. Desirable / Preference: Preference will be given to candidates with computer proficiency, typing knowledge, administrative aptitude, and experience in handling technical tasks. Age Limit: 58 to 65 years. | Eligibility: Retired government personnel having a minimum of 3 years of work experience on the post of Section Officer. Must possess practical experience in handling budget-related matters, establishment matters, and court cases. Desirable / Preference: Preference will be given to candidates possessing computer knowledge, typing skills, administrative aptitude, and technical work experience. Age Limit: 58 to 65 years. | Eligibility: Retired government personnel having a minimum of 3 years of work experience on the post of Assistant Section Officer. Must have practical experience in dealing with budget matters, establishment affairs, and legal/court cases. Desirable / Preference: Preference will be given to candidates with computer knowledge, typing skills, administrative background, and technical work experience. Age Limit: 58 to 65 years.

important_instructions: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis for a duration of 1 year on fixed honorarium terms. Appointees under the contract scheme will hold no formal post designation. Contractual staff are not entitled to earned leave, casual leave, or medical leave. The appointed person will not hold any administrative or financial powers and is strictly not authorized to sign any official government letter or order. All appointees are individually responsible for completing the specific tasks assigned to them during the tenure.

content_sections.heading: About MEDD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Medical Education Department operates under the Government of Maharashtra, headquartered at the Gokuldas Tejpal Hospital Complex Building, New Mantralaya, Lokmanya Tilak Marg, Mumbai. It oversees medical education, clinical administration, and institutional hospital infrastructure across the state. This recruitment engages retired personnel on a contract basis for an initial duration of one year to clear specific administrative backlogs.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must compile their application form along with self-attested copies of required certificates and submit it in person or by post to the following single-line address: Establishment, Medical Education Department, Gokuldas Tejpal Hospital Complex Building, 9th Floor, New Mantralaya, Lokmanya Tilak Marg, Mumbai - 400001. The official notification does not provide a separate prescribed form layout or specify envelope endorsements. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in MEDD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies, including 1 post of Senior Stenographer, 2 posts of Section Officer, and 2 posts of Assistant Section Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MEDD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications along with required certificates is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only retired government personnel who have at least 3 years of experience on the concerned post are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for all three posts is 58 to 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for the posts?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration and allowances will be determined as per the Maharashtra General Administration Department Government Resolution dated 10 June 2025.

faq.question: Q6. How can eligible candidates apply?
faq.answer: Eligible retired officers must submit their application with medical fitness, qualification, and experience certificates to the Establishment Section, Medical Education Department, 9th Floor, GT Hospital Complex, New Mantralaya, Mumbai by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on a contract basis for a period of 1 year.

faq.question: Q8. Are contractual employees entitled to leave benefits?
faq.answer: No, appointees are not entitled to earned leave, casual leave, or medical leave.

faq.question: Q9. Do contractual appointees possess signing or administrative powers?
faq.answer: No, contractual appointees hold no administrative or financial powers and are not permitted to sign government letters or orders.
